newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi shipping firm to take delivery of new vessel.
newsitem.headline: Saudi shipping firm to take delivery of new vessel.

text.p: The National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia (NSCSA) said on Sunday it would take delivery of its fifth very large crude carrier (VLCC) this month.
The 300,000 deadweight tonne vessel will be named Safaniyah during a ceremony on Wednesday at Mitsubishi Heavy Industries 7011.t shipyard at Nagasaki, Japan, a company statement said.
The $400 million ship will be the last of five vessels ordered from the Japanese firm by NSCSA, 28.8 percent owned by the Saudi government.
The vessels will carry crude produced by Saudi Aramco under a three-year agreement signed with Aramco's shipping arm Vela International Marine last year.
